Spectral Lance.note: The lance aims for the head, so headshots will likely make it do more in practice

Wall of Sparks.note: Counts a single explosion: it can do up to four, and some sparks

Rolling Sparks.note: Counts a single explosion: bigger enemies can take more, and more sparks

followUps.label: R2
followUps.note: Counts one hit of its flame pillars, which can hit several times

Promised Consort.note: Doesn't count its small light projectiles, which may miss: {damage} damage each

Lightspeed Slash.note: Counts one hit of each of its light beams, which land at random and can hit many times

Destined Death.note: Counts its swings' Destined Death after the projectiles lower the enemy's max HP: it can do a little more if they hit later

Wing of Astel.note: Counts 4 of its 11 explosions, as many as hit a human-sized enemy: bigger ones can take more

Bastard's Stars.note: Counts one hit of its projectile, which can hit several times

Unending Dance.note: Counts its opening slash and one cycle of its 12 looping slashes, which keep cycling while the skill is held and can stop early

I Command Thee, Kneel!.note: Counts its shockwaves: point blank, its axe hits instead and it does less

Bubble Shower.note: Counts the 6 bubbles that usually hit a human-sized enemy: bigger enemies can take more

Surge of Faith.note: Doesn't count its 36 small projectiles an explosion, which fly at random: {damage} damage each

Erdtree Slam.note: Counts its slam close up: further away, only its weaker shockwave hits

Spinning Wheel.note: Counts its downswing, 7 opening spins, and its two loops of 8 and 10: it keeps looping while the skill is held

Spearcall Ritual.note: Counts one of its spears: about 14 fall at random, and how many hit depends on the target

Frenzyflame Thrust.note: Counts its explosion from a slight distance: point blank, its thrust hits instead ({damage})

Bloodfiends' Bloodboon.note: Counts its bullets' most hits, 4, 4, and 8: in practice they hit less

Bloodboon Ritual.note: Counts its bullets' most ticks, 4, 4, and 8: in practice they hit less

Romina's Purification.note: Counts 3 hits of its bullet, which can hit more or fewer times

Sea of Magma.note: Counts it without looping: each loop while held adds the lash and magma tick in parentheses, and the magma can tick once more

Bear Witness!.note: Counts its fire and explosion: up close its windup's weapon hit and more fire can hit too, and its 18 projectiles land at random ({damage} each), leaving patches of fire

Fires of Slumber.note: Only builds up sleep: counts 2 hits of its fire, which can hit more often over the stream

Deadly Poison Spray.note: Does no damage, only deadly poison: counts its sprays' 6 hits, but it keeps building up for about a second, much more in all
